data: NVIDIA's fiscal 2023, which ended January 29, 2023, had revenue of about $26.97 billion. On a GAAP basis, gross profit was about $15.36 billion, a gross margin of roughly 56.9%, and operating income was about $4.22 billion, an operating margin of roughly 15.7%. The year was depressed by a large inventory charge and the gaming market downturn, which is why margins were well below the company's later results. Figures are from NVIDIA's FY2023 10-K and may differ slightly if you use non-GAAP measures.
